purpose: Production cleanup of user-approved troop concept sheets for Meshy inputs

sheets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this approved 4-panel troop concept sheet. Prepare a CLEAN MODELING REFERENCE CONTACT SHEET of the EXACT SAME FOUR HERO UNITS for image-to-3D and animation rigging. Preserve each unit's identity, silhouette, armor, creature anatomy, weapons, palette and material design. Remove every title, label, frame, arrow, ground scenery, VFX, shadow, miniature pose figure and animation strip. Exactly four LARGE individual full-body hero units in a precise evenly spaced 2-by-2 grid on plain white background, each entirely contained in its own quadrant with a 12% margin around it. No fifth unit. Top left light, top right heavy, bottom left air, bottom right ultimate. Make each subject cleanly separated from all other quadrants; empty white horizontal and vertical gutters at center. All feet, wings, tails and weapons fully visible.
Front three-quarter view for creatures and machines, neutral balanced stance with separate limbs and open negative space between legs; wings fully spread, cannons at rest. Humanoid figures in relaxed symmetrical A-POSE with clear separated arms angled down 35 degrees from horizontal, straight knees and separate feet facing forward. Their rifle is held lowered alongside one hand, never crossing the torso or obscuring the legs. Do not remove or redesign characteristic weapons. No battle poses, attack effects, particles, platforms, bases, UI, text or watermark. Clean evenly lit stylized 3D asset render; no hard baked shadows. This is production reference cleanup, not a redesign.
The top-left Sentinel is a humanoid robot and must have a clean A-pose.
